results.question: What is total net revenue for each top-level product category (the categories that have no parent)?
results.goldSql: SELECT parent.CategoryName, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.OrderItems oi JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId JOIN catalog.Categories c ON c.CategoryId = p.CategoryId JOIN catalog.Categories parent ON parent.CategoryId = c.ParentCategoryId GROUP BY parent.CategoryName
results.sql:
SELECT
    c.[CategoryName],
    SUM(oi.[Quantity] * oi.[UnitPrice] * (1 - oi.[DiscountPct])) AS [TotalNetRevenue]
FROM [catalog].[Categories] AS c
INNER JOIN [catalog].[Products] AS p
    ON p.[CategoryId] = c.[CategoryId]
INNER JOIN [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
    ON oi.[ProductId] = p.[ProductId]
WHERE c.[ParentCategoryId] IS NULL
GROUP BY c.[CategoryId], c.[CategoryName];

results.question: What is total net revenue for each top-level product category (the categories that have no parent)?
results.goldSql: SELECT parent.CategoryName, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.OrderItems oi JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId JOIN catalog.Categories c ON c.CategoryId = p.CategoryId JOIN catalog.Categories parent ON parent.CategoryId = c.ParentCategoryId GROUP BY parent.CategoryName
results.sql:
WITH [CategoryHierarchy] AS (
    SELECT
        [c].[CategoryId] AS [TopCategoryId],
        [c].[CategoryId] AS [CategoryId]
    FROM [catalog].[Categories] AS [c]
    WHERE [c].[ParentCategoryId] IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        [h].[TopCategoryId],
        [child].[CategoryId]
    FROM [CategoryHierarchy] AS [h]
    JOIN [catalog].[Categories] AS [child]
        ON [child].[ParentCategoryId] = [h].[CategoryId]
)
SELECT
    [root].[CategoryName],
    COALESCE(SUM([oi].[Quantity] * [oi].[UnitPrice] * (1 - [oi].[DiscountPct])), 0) AS [TotalNetRevenue]
FROM [catalog].[Categories] AS [root]
LEFT JOIN [CategoryHierarchy] AS [h]
    ON [h].[TopCategoryId] = [root].[CategoryId]
LEFT JOIN [catalog].[Products] AS [p]
    ON [p].[CategoryId] = [h].[CategoryId]
LEFT JOIN [sales].[OrderItems] AS [oi]
    ON [oi].[ProductId] = [p].[ProductId]
WHERE [root].[ParentCategoryId] IS NULL
GROUP BY [root].[CategoryId], [root].[CategoryName]
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100);

results.goldSql: SELECT parent.CategoryName, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.OrderItems oi JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId JOIN catalog.Categories c ON c.CategoryId = p.CategoryId JOIN catalog.Categories parent ON parent.CategoryId = c.ParentCategoryId GROUP BY parent.CategoryName
results.sql:
WITH [CategoryTree] AS (
    SELECT
        c.[CategoryId] AS [TopLevelCategoryId],
        c.[CategoryName] AS [TopLevelCategoryName],
        c.[CategoryId] AS [CategoryId]
    FROM [catalog].[Categories] AS c
    WHERE c.[ParentCategoryId] IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ct.[TopLevelCategoryId],
        ct.[TopLevelCategoryName],
        child.[CategoryId]
    FROM [CategoryTree] AS ct
    JOIN [catalog].[Categories] AS child
        ON child.[ParentCategoryId] = ct.[CategoryId]
)
SELECT
    ct.[TopLevelCategoryName],
    SUM(oi.[Quantity] * oi.[UnitPrice] * (1 - oi.[DiscountPct])) AS [TotalNetRevenue]
FROM [CategoryTree] AS ct
JOIN [catalog].[Products] AS p
    ON p.[CategoryId] = ct.[CategoryId]
JOIN [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
    ON oi.[ProductId] = p.[ProductId]
GROUP BY ct.[TopLevelCategoryId], ct.[TopLevelCategoryName];
